description: SEC Form 4 insider trading for one US stock ticker — every insider buy/sell/grant/gift in the window (name, role, date, code, shares, price, shares owned after, filing URL) plus open-market buy vs sell totals. Costs $0.01 per call, paid from clink's shop credits (get a key with buy_credits or at /buy/credits). A failed or empty call is free.
